# Vendored Pelmet components

These directories are copied from the Dimble source repository
(<https://github.com/fif7y/dimble>), commit `23a5412` (Dimble 0.3.2, build 71;
originally named Pelmet).

They are licensed under **GNU GPL version 3**; see `../LICENSE` and
